name: Dat Big Nasty Strain Art Series Bubble Hash Infused Pre-Roll | 1G
description:
A masterpiece of craftsmanship and purity. Each pre-roll is a curated blend of full flower and premium Icewater Bubble Hash, meticulously crafted to deliver and unparalleled experience. With no added terpenes, you'll savor the true essence and natural flavor profile of the Cannabis plant. Elevate your sessions with the strain art series- Where art meet nature in every puff.
